Thanks for the heads up. I’ve logged this as a risk to the MAP and proposed three mitigation tracks below — aim is to keep the close window within two weeks of the original target.

Risk log entry (short):
- Risk: SOC2 evidence/gap review may extend procurement security sign-off by ~10 business days.
- Impact: Procurement milestone slip -> PO delayed; target close (2026-04-01) at risk.
- Likelihood: Medium (healthcare, PHI adjacency).

Mitigation options (pick 2 for faster resolution):
1) Interim attestation + redacted logs: Redwood can provide a scoped attestation and redacted findings within 3 business days.
2) Priority security review: Redwood to open a priority queue with our SOC/compliance team and provide a 1-hour live walkthrough with Nova security (we’ll do this within 48 hours).
3) Contract-level workaround: Short-term pilot MSA (30-day limited PII scope) so procurement can approve commercial terms while security completes full review.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Today: I’ll upload redacted logs and the scoped attestation to the Drive folder and ping your security lead. (Action: Karthik)
- Mon 16 Mar: 1-hour live walkthrough (action: Redwood compliance + Nova security).
- If confirmation received by Tue 17 Mar, procurement pushes to complete review by Mon 23 Mar and we can keep the April 1-ish implementation.

If we don’t secure an interim attestation this week, please expect a re-baselined close of 2026-04-15. I’m copying Marcus to enable an executive escalation if needed (discount/credit requests or SLA concessions).

Best,
Karthik
